description:
News about one football club from gol24.uz, newest first. Use it instead of search_news whenever the question is about a specific club ("latest Real Madrid news", "Barcelona transfers"). For a player or coach use person_news; for general news use latest_news.
The club is matched by its name (English names work: "Real Madrid", "Manchester City", "Paxtakor") or a partial name. Optional type filter, e.g. type="transfer" for transfer news only.
Returns the matched club name, its gol24.uz page and up to `limit` items (default 10, max 20) with the same fields as latest_news. If the club is unknown, returns an error listing similar club names - retry with one of them. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

club.description: Club name in English or Uzbek, e.g. "Real Madrid", "Manchester City", "Paxtakor". A partial name picks the best-known matching club, so prefer the full name.

type.description: Optional. transfer = transfers and rumours; matbuot = press quotes and interviews; natija = final match results; umumiy = everything else. Omit for all types.

name: club_news
title: Club News
